question: When the river approaches sea it breaks up into a number of distributaries, each distributary forms its own mouth. The collection of sediments from all the mouths forms _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**delta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• About River Delta-

 
 
• At the mouth of the delta river, there is a triangular form of deposition of sediments brought by it.
